economics_interpretation.interpretation: Using the three sensitivity scenarios provided, unit contribution margins range from approximately $2.00 to $3.80 before payment processing and fixed fees. Contribution is highly sensitive to landed cost structure (factory, packaging, freight, duty, import overhead) and retail price. Retail price assumptions are anchored to observed marketplace premiums. Payment processing reduces effective margin by ~3.0% plus $0.30 fixed per order. No conclusion on overall business viability can be drawn without actual supplier quotes, fulfillment contracts, breakage rates, and demand forecasts.
